selection: Curated featured singles; not sales-volume rankings

abilities.name: Dark Signal
abilities.effect: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Azure Pulse
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Max Burst
attacks.effect: You may discard any amount of basic Fire Energy or any amount of basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Precious Touch
attacks.effect: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal 120 damage from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Harmony
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

abilities.name: Crystal Veil
abilities.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX, except any Glaceon VMAX.

attacks.name: Max Icicle
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Grass Knot
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Max Leaf
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cross Fusion Strike
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Max Miracle
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Solar Revelation
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached.(Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Max Mindstorm
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Abyss Seeking
attacks.effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Put the other cards in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Read the Wind
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Aero Dive
attacks.effect: You may discard a Stadium in play.

cards.name: Serena
cards.effect:
Choose 1:
• Discard up to 3 cards from your hand. (You must discard at least 1 card.) If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
• Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon V with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Trinity Nova
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon V in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Lost Impact
attacks.effect: Put 2 Energy attached to your Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Star Requiem
attacks.effect: You can use this attack only if you have 10 or more cards in the Lost Zone. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Star Chronos
attacks.effect: Take another turn after this one. (Skip Pokémon Checkup.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Subspace Swell
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Brave Wing
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Explosive Vortex
attacks.effect: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Tranquil Flower
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dangerous Toxwhip
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

abilities.name: Solid Shell
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Twin Cannons
attacks.effect: Discard up to 2 Basic {W} Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 140 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

abilities.name: Voltaic Float
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon has any {L} Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Multishot Lightning
attacks.effect: This attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Frenzied Gouging
attacks.effect: Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon. If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out in this way, this Pokémon does 200 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Calamity Storm
attacks.effect: You may discard a Stadium in play. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Shinobi Blade
attacks.effect: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mirage Barrage
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Carmine
cards.effect:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

abilities.name: Resolute Heart
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Topaz Bolt
attacks.effect: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Skyliner
abilities.effect: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Eon Blade
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Moon Mirage
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Onyx
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and take a Prize card.

attacks.name: Magical Charm
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 100 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Angelite
attacks.effect: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Shuffle those Pokémon and all attached cards into your opponent's deck. If 1 of your Pokémon used Angelite during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

abilities.name: Rainbow DNA
abilities.effect: This Pokémon can evolve into any Pokémon ex that evolves from Eevee if you play it from your hand onto this Pokémon. (This Pokémon can't evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.)

cards.name: Iono
cards.effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

cards.name: Miriam
cards.effect: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck. If you shuffled any cards into your deck in this way, draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
